commentary.text: 90+6' Juan Martinez is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
90+3' Wesley (Real Sociedad) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
90+1' Luis Garcia Plaza decides to make a substitution. Chidera Ejuke will be replaced by Oso (Sevilla).
90+1' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Neal Maupay walks off the pitch to be replaced by Peque (Sevilla).
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
89' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
88' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
88' Juan Martinez shows a yellow card to Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) for his blatant foul.
84' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
82' Substitution. Jon Aramburu walks off the pitch and Wesley (Real Sociedad) comes on as a substitute.
82' Here is a change. Ander Barrenetxea is going off and Pellegrino Matarazzo gives the last tactical orders to Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad).
82' The manager makes a subsitution with Batista Mendy (Sevilla) coming on for Nemanja Gudelj.
81' A goal, which was scored by Lucien Agoume (Sevilla), was disallowed due to offside.
78' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
75' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to make a change. Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) replaces Ruben Vargas.
75' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Martinez had an easy-decision to make.
74' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) forces a pass into the box, but Odysseas Vlachodimos is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
73' Good clearance! Neal Maupay (Sevilla) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
69' Substitution. Yangel Herrera (Real Sociedad) has come on for Benat Turrientes.
69' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
69' Juan Martinez couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) and blew his whistle.
68' The Real Sociedad players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
66' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad).
64' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Odysseas Vlachodimos has no trouble gathering it.
63' The resulting corner, taken by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad), comes to nothing. Real Sociedad have a corner.
62' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) is able to continue to play.
60' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
60' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
58' Substitution. Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) replaces Pablo Marin.
58' Kike Salas (Sevilla) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes well over the bar.
57' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
56' A cross into the box from Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) is cleared.
55' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alex Remiro, who smothers the ball.
53' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
50' 1 - 0 Goal! Neal Maupay plays a simple square pass into the feet of Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
48' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) and Ruben Vargas try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
46' A pass by Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
46' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) replacing Jon Gorrotxategi.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Isaac Romero comes off for Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' The linesman raises his flag. Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) is adjudged offside.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

44' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) controls the ball and sets off to face the goalkeeper, but deep inside the box the ball bounces up on the uneven surface and makes him miss the strike, sending the ball well over the goal.
43' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders.
42' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
40' This shall not pass! Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
38' The ball is cleared after Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
36' Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.

35' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
34' The game is interrupted now, Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
32' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
32' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee blows his whistle, Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.
30' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) picks up a short pass and immediately fires a shot towards the bottom left corner from distance, but Alex Remiro hardly has to move and makes a very easy save.
28' Luis Garcia Plaza is stunned as referee Juan Martinez shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
28' The game has begun to heat up. Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
27' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) commits a foul and Juan Martinez immediately signals a free kick.
27' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) takes the corner but it's cleared.
26' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away. The referee signals a corner kick to Real Sociedad.
25' Neal Maupay (Sevilla) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
21' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Alex Remiro has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
20' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Juan Martinez blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
17' The resulting corner from Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

16' A sweet pass finds Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Alex Remiro is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.

14' Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner kick and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the right post.
13' There's an opportunity for Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

13' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way. The linesman makes the right call and Sevilla will have a corner.
11' Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
10' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) and Lucien Agoume try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
7' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
6' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
5' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Juan Martinez who sees an offensive foul.
4' A pass from Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is intercepted by Odysseas Vlachodimos and the move breaks down.
2' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
1' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
1' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Real Sociedad are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
1' The match has just started.
Real Sociedad will kick-off.
